name: MetaSEM
method_summary: MetaSEM infers gene regulatory networks from scRNA-seq data with a meta-learning framework composed of an encoder, a meta-decoder and a GRN layer. The GRN layer embeds a structural equation model adjacency matrix as directed regulatory weights, and bi-level optimization trains the encoder and meta-decoder to learn pseudo-labels from sparse high-dimensional single-cell expression data.

threading.upstream_mapping: MetaSEM exposes no public worker, n_jobs or CLI thread argument. The selected implementation is PyTorch-based; the wrapper should map ANDREA --threads to PyTorch CPU intra-op threads with torch.set_num_threads(threads), keep PyTorch inter-op threads at 1, and set common BLAS/OpenMP environment variables such as OMP_NUM_THREADS, MKL_NUM_THREADS, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS, NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS, BLIS_NUM_THREADS and VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS to the assigned thread count before invoking MetaSEM. DataLoader num_workers remains the upstream default 0.

compatibility_rules.message: MetaSEM requires at least two expression genes.

conditional_required.message: prior_grn is required when pseudo_grn_mode=provided_prior because MetaSEM uses the provided network as its upstream net_path label/prior file.
conditional_required.usage: Wrapper converts normalized prior_grn.tsv to MetaSEM's net_path CSV with Gene1 and Gene2 columns. In this mode MetaSEM uses the network to identify candidate TFs and target genes, construct the TF mask, initialize label-derived pseudo targets, and compute epoch metrics.

conditional_required.message: groups is required when execution.mode=group_emulated because ANDREA partitions the dataset by group before running MetaSEM.
conditional_required.usage: ANDREA uses groups.tsv to create one single-group MetaSEM child run per group; each child follows the global GRN-inference path and MetaSEM itself does not consume groups.tsv.

progress.note: The selected GRN-inference implementation prints one status line per training epoch; after applying the documented source patch, the wrapper should report iteration progress from the configured epochs plus coarse setup/export states.

pseudo_grn_mode.description: How the wrapper supplies MetaSEM's required net_path file. unlabeled_all_genes generates a deterministic all-expression-gene pseudo scaffold and runs MetaSEM with is_label=false, matching the tutorial's no-ground-truth path. provided_prior requires prior_grn and runs with is_label=true.

epochs.description: Number of MetaSEM training epochs. Upstream tutorial and default GRN_inference path use 20; the wrapper should apply a source patch so this controls the training loop instead of the hard-coded value.

batch_size.description: Training minibatch size. Upstream tutorial and default GRN_inference path use 64; the wrapper should apply a source patch so this controls the DataLoader batch size.

alpha.description: GRN-layer alpha coefficient used in the meta-decoder update. The documented GRN_inference/default path sets alpha to 0.45.

lr.description: Adam learning rate for the encoder/main network in the selected GRN_inference/default path.

lr_meta.description: Adam learning rate for the MetaSEM meta-decoder network in the selected GRN_inference/default path.

gamma.description: Learning-rate decay factor for the encoder/main-network scheduler in the selected GRN_inference/default path.

gamma_meta.description: Learning-rate decay factor for the meta-decoder scheduler in the selected GRN_inference/default path.

random_seed.description: Seed used for Python, NumPy and PyTorch reproducibility. This matches the seed hard-coded in the reviewed upstream training modules.

artifacts_aux.description: Combined stdout/stderr log from the MetaSEM run, including upstream epoch metrics.
